messages:
Aisha Gomez: Quick sync request — vendors want a single embargo window but our marketplace needs region-staggered SKUs for capacity gating. Can we propose a plan that satisfies both?

Marco Li: Happy to draft. My thinking: single global press embargo date, but marketplace SKU availability toggled per-region based on vendor capacity CSV. That way PR can speak with one voice while ops still gates rollout.

Vikram Shah: Agree. Need two more items: (1) SKU naming conventions (e.g., redwood-h100-standard, redwood-mi300-optimized), (2) a dry-run with SIs to validate driver+image combos before soft-listing.

Dana Ortiz: Legal/PR note: we need partner logo approvals and partner quote signoff 72 hours before embargo lift. Also, any marketplace copy referencing performance numbers must be approved by research.

Nina (Vendor Liaison): From vendor side: H100 availability is solid in NA/EU, limited APAC for first 2 weeks. MI300 is NA first, then EU. Gaudi availability is APAC-first for some partners. We'll provide a per-region capacity CSV by EOD tomorrow.

Marco Li: Great — CSV will drive the SKU visibility matrix. I'll convert it into a JSON gating file for the console: {"region": ["enabled_skills"]} — will include fallback options when capacity < X.

Vikram Shah: Fallbacks: plan to auto-route to a quantized variant (q4_0) if vendor reports < 20% projected capacity. Also need telemetry hooks to flip routing in real-time.

Aisha Gomez: Operational constraints: we must tag all release tickets with `hw-rollout-v2` and attach the gating JSON. Also create an internal-only marketplace view for SI onboarding.

PRBot: Reminder: create PR brief doc in /shared/pr with embargo_date, partner_list, approved_quotes. PR will not post without `partner_logo_ok` flag.

Dana Ortiz: I'll own the logo checklist and partner quote approvals. Can we get a dry-run date? Recommend internal dry-run Day 2 after vendor baseline.

Nina (Vendor Liaison): Day 2 dry-run OK for vendors who have completed driver baseline. We'll mark those in the CSV with "baseline=true".

Vikram Shah: CI-Check, can we add a smoke test that runs on the dry-run image and validates 95th percentile latency under target for sample prompts?

CI-Check: Added job `hw-dryrun-smoke` to pipelines. It will run against `redwood/hw-dryrun:<vendor>-<date>` and post results to the release ticket.

Marco Li: Timeline proposal:

- Day 0: vendor confirms capacity CSV + driver baseline flag
- Day 2: SI dry-run (internal marketplace view)
- Day 4: soft-listing in allowed regions (restricted access)
- Day 7: global embargo lift (public PR)
- Day 14: full regional flares + telemetry ramp to 100%

Aisha Gomez: That timeline works. Action owners: Marco = gating JSON + SKU naming, Nina = vendor CSV, Dana = legal/partner approvals, Vikram = fallbacks + telemetry, CI-Check = smoke job. I'll create the JIRA epic and invite all owners.

PRBot: Note: ensure `partner_logo_ok` and `research_performance_signoff` fields are present in the JIRA ticket.

Nina (Vendor Liaison): Uploading initial CSV in 3 hours. Expect H100 NA/EU numbers and Gaudi APAC flags.

Vikram Shah: One more — add runbook step for emergency rollback if driver misbehaves post-launch.

Aisha Gomez: Will add rollback steps to the release ticket and a short on-call rota for the first 48 hours after public. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
